decisions.decision: Resolve Destination on deliver-flatstock from the request's own requesting work centre
decisions.why: the documented deliver rule is that a Deliver Item goes to the requesting work centre with no user entry, so the value exists and nothing is invented
decisions.rejected: reintroducing the retired answer-sourced Destination question, which DestinationQuestionRetirementTests pins as illegal

decisions.decision: One new Infor Visual read shape for the part-wide quantity filtered by location class, plus the WIP floor sum for WIP stock
decisions.why: FR-090 requires the full sum for the part from the source that holds it for the item type, and D38 names those two sources
decisions.rejected: PART.QTY_ON_HAND, which is total on-hand with no location filter and is the defect FR-090 records

decisions.decision: Draw the time ring with the platform ProgressRing in its determinate state with the time text overlaid
decisions.why: Microsoft Learn documents a determinate state for ProgressRing that shows percentage completed and does not block interaction, and the control is read-only so it cannot be mistaken for the click target
decisions.rejected: hand-drawn arc geometry with Path and ArcSegment, which is custom work with no theming or accessibility path

decisions.decision: Realise D31 as one DataTemplate per Item in a single ResourceDictionary chosen by a DataTemplateSelector
decisions.why: a WinUI UserControl needs its own XAML file so 24 controls cannot share one, while templates keep 24 arrangements in one file and are the documented way to select a template from an item's own properties
decisions.rejected: 24 UserControls, which is the file-per-card bloat D31 forbids, and an imperative cell builder, which throws away XAML binding and the markup tests

decisions.decision: Store the handler condition in a new nullable handler_status column written by a new gated stored procedure
decisions.why: the condition is set on the card and must be restored on the next list read, and keeping it out of status preserves the lifecycle word that the precedence rule needs
decisions.rejected: overloading status, which loses the lifecycle state, and a client-side store, which FR-073 forbids

decisions.decision: Store the new answers in a nullable answers_json column carried by the request insert and the list read
decisions.why: the die Items now ask two questions and the four returning pickups ask one each, so a single input_value can no longer hold everything an Item asks
decisions.rejected: a waitlist_request_answers table, which adds a join and a second write for at most two values per request

decisions.decision: For FR-090, correct the query input and leave the classifier rule untouched
decisions.why: the classifier already documents the finished-goods location rule and only the value handed to it is wrong, so fixing the input is the smallest truthful change
decisions.rejected: amending the rule text, which clarify owns and which is not required to make Part Type truthful

decisions.decision: For FR-095, leave the dunnage Description declaration in place and never draw the cell
decisions.why: it is the spec's own edge case that configuration is left alone when a declared field must not be drawn, and it invents nothing
decisions.rejected: deleting the declaration, a silent change to shipped configuration that clarify should own

decisions.decision: Derive Part Type and Item Type by wiring the existing RequestDispositionResolver, extended with an Ncm state
decisions.why: the stack is already built, registered and consumed by nothing, so giving it its first consumer is smaller than a second derivation, and NCM is a location state the classifier has no value for
decisions.rejected: a fresh derivation inside the card, which duplicates live-validated rules

decisions.decision: Source the fuzzy incorrect-part search from a new live-only Infor Visual query with no mirror declaration
decisions.why: D24 and the spec Assumptions settle that a contains-search over every part is not mirrorable and must degrade to the typed value rather than a stale answer
decisions.rejected: reusing the receiving application WinForms picker, which the pre-spec records cannot be reused verbatim, and a cached reply, which would serve a stale part list

decisions.decision: Source Home Location by extending the internal dunnage read to carry the dunnage home location
decisions.why: the internal store already holds the value, so the internal live read is the smallest source
decisions.rejected: a new Infor Visual read for a value an internal table already holds

decisions.decision: Source 'Average coil weight' from the extended coil subordinate read as CAST(COALESCE(part.WEIGHT,0) AS decimal(20,8))
decisions.why: R1 said to carry it on the existing snapshot rather than a second read, and VISUAL's PART.WEIGHT decimal(14,4) was confirmed in the schema export at Documents/Development/InforVisual/DatabaseCSVFiles/ColumnDetails/PART.csv, so the source is grounded rather than assumed
decisions.rejected: resolving it from the receiving store's sp_receiving_history_average_coil_weight, which R1 rejected as a second read

decisions.decision: New mirrorable shape part_warehouse_quantities with one row per part and three columns (PartNumber, WarehouseQuantity, FinishedGoodsQuantity)
decisions.why: FR-090 needs the full part-wide sum from the source that holds it, and the finished-goods split needs a location-class filter; one row per part makes the mirror key the part number, the same arrangement as inventory_locations
decisions.rejected: a per-location figure or PART.QTY_ON_HAND, both of which are the defect FR-090 records

decisions.decision: Added RingText to SampleOrder and bound the card's overlaid ring text to it, so a closed request's ring draws the time taken
decisions.why: FR-015 requires the ring to carry time left while live and time taken once closed, and no member produced a time-taken string; the card had bound RemainingTimeText, which is always a countdown. This corrected a real gap in US1's delivered slice
decisions.rejected: leaving the countdown frozen on a closed ring, which is what the card did before

decisions.decision: Extended the subordinate_parts mirror (both tables, both procedures, the row model and the fallback) with average_weight, and extended T012's scope to two consumer mapping files
decisions.why: the task list left these seams unowned: the projection change T010/T011/ the catalog made could not be read without the mirror column, and home_location could not reach the snapshot without the two mappers
decisions.rejected: leaving the mirror short a column, which makes a host that validates the catalog report the shape invalid

decisions.decision: Reconciled the item seed exactly as data-model §9 requires: the label moves (Die Location, Home Location, Scrap Type, Coil Number), the new answer cells (Die Shop Direction, Size, # of Skids, Weight of Coil), the new derivation and read cells (Part Type, Item Type, Total Qty In House), the two wrong-part Items' source correction to answer, and nothing removed

decisions.decision: Added Die Location as a second resolver arm alongside Pickup location

decisions.decision: Exempted the 11 bare-label resource keys in the naming guard, with the reason in the script

decisions.rejected: renaming the labels to key shape, which breaks the declaration and draws the raw key as the label

decisions.decision: FR-095: kept the dunnage Description declaration and never draw the cell
decisions.why: it is the spec's own edge case and the inverse of inventing a value; the seed-alignment and template tests assert the card draws nothing for it
decisions.rejected: deleting the declaration as a silent scope cut

decisions.decision: The action grid is 3 columns x 2 rows (D44). Section 4 of the pre-spec has always shown this table; only the prose around it (section 1 bullet 4, D18, FR-061) said 2x3, so the built card followed stale prose. Corrected in the pre-spec, FR-061 and data-model.md.

The Windows resource index is case-insensitive: adding a key that differs only in case from an existing one fails the build with PRI277 Conflicting values. This settles that the three renamed cell labels (Coil number, Home location, Scrap type) already resolve through their canonical spellings, so they need no old-spelling entry. The label-resolution test therefore compares case-insensitively.

A DataTemplateSelector used by a ContentControl must override BOTH SelectTemplateCore overloads. Overriding only the one-argument overload leaves the base implementation answering the two-argument question with null, so the presenter draws its content instead of the template. This silently disabled the entire per-Item cell system and could not be caught by any unit test, because the framework is what asks the question.

An overdue live row's ring carries the signed time overrun (-hh:mm) rather than RemainingTimeText, which is the word 'Overdue' once the due time has passed. FR-014 requires the word on row 1 and the overrun in the ring, so keeping them as one value printed the word twice. RemainingTimeText is left unchanged because the request detail page reads it as a word.

Removed the card print action and its TODO logic at the owner direction; printing belongs to the request detail page later. FR-067 is superseded, FR-061 amended from six buttons to five, and SC-012, acceptance scenario 6, FR-104 and the scope note updated in place. Recorded as D59, superseding D4 and D54.
decisions.why: Printing a label needs the detail a label is made of, which the request page has; the card placeholder performed nothing and the platform disabled state faded it until its glyph was invisible, so it read as an empty box on every card.

decisions.decision: The app names people by name and never prints an employee number. The queue keeps recording the material handler as an employee number, because that is what the handler authorizations compare; the name is resolved beside it from the entry the handler themselves wrote, matched to that same handler number, by both request reads. PersonText reads the name and nothing else, and a claimed request whose handler carries no recorded name draws no person row rather than falling back to the number. The request detail page no longer draws its Employee number row.
decisions.why: A claimed card read 6229 under the ring where the name of the person holding the work belongs. The number was the only thing the row had, because that is how the assignment is stored.

implement.summary: The waitlist line card rebuilt to its four-zone anatomy with an eight-state three-theme status column, a per-Item detail template for all 24 Items with geometry by cell count, a handler-condition flyout, the four returning pickups unhidden behind real job gates and their Part Type derived from the disposition stack, the five new New Request answers collected and persisted into answers_json, and the item seed, aggregates and contracts reconciled to all of it. 83 of 93 tasks ticked; the remaining 10 need a live store, a reachable Infor Visual host or a rendered app.

approach: Four workstreams land the change: the card control and its host page are rebuilt into four zones, the status zone gains a determinate ProgressRing and a three-theme palette, the detail column becomes one DataTemplate per Item in a single resource dictionary, and every cell that has no source today gets one named mechanism (extend the label map, extend the snapshot, read from the plant system, derive through the existing disposition stack, or capture a new answer). Behind it, one new nullable column and two stored procedures carry the handler condition and the new answers, the seed is reconciled with the pre-spec's cell assignment, and the four hidden pickups are unhidden behind real job gates.

concerns.note: No live store and no plant system exist in this environment, so eight tasks' stated verifications could not be run and were deliberately left unticked: T048 (drive the six status states on a built card against SC-006/SC-007), T058 (choose a condition, reload, confirm SC-016, restart), T067 (live-database finished-goods validation), T068 (record the codes T067 found), T069 (drive the picker for each job kind against SC-010), T071 (run GetPartMatches.sql against Infor Visual for an exact and a partial term), T079 (one request per new answer checked against SC-015), T088 (screen-reader, keyboard-only flyout walk, clipping at the default window size, animations-off). The Infor Visual host is unresolvable here (No such host is known) and the app's own store is not provisioned.

Six pre-existing test failures remain, all one cause: Module_Startup AcceptanceSurfaceTests reads a repo-root STARTUP-REBUILD-BRIEF.md that does not exist. They were failing at T001's recorded baseline before any of this work (baseline 1901 passed / 6 failed / 46 skipped) and the final run reproduces exactly the same six (2114 passed / 6 failed / 47 skipped, 2167 total). This feature introduced zero new failures.

Two of T092's four guard scripts exit 1 on grandfathered findings that predate this feature: validate-csharp-xaml-naming.ps1 reports 267 findings repo-wide and validate-sql-naming.ps1 reports 13, in three grandfathered classes (7 *_population.sql filenames - the new part_warehouse_quantities_population.sql is one, its filename fixed by the mock loader's path convention and identical to its six siblings - 2 Mock.Service/Restore filenames, 4 boolean-name findings). None is attributable to this feature: the four the feature had introduced were fixed, dropping the count from 271 to 267.

The eight status words and the four handler conditions are deliberately NOT localised. They are the store's vocabulary: HandlerStatusCatalog compares them ordinally, the flyout writes them verbatim, the list read restores them, and tests pin them verbatim. Giving them a resource value would break that round trip, so FR-104's 'every new string is a resource key' cannot be met for those twelve without a behaviour change. Recorded rather than silently claimed.

FR-090 remains open at its live leg only: the query input is corrected and the classifier's rule is untouched, but the finished-goods and NCM location codes this installation actually uses are unconfirmed because T067's live validation could not run. Database/Validation/disposition_input_finished_goods/validate.sql was written and can discover them by querying VISUAL.ENUM_CODES for TABLE_NAME='PART_LOCATION'/COLUMN_NAME='STATUS' and TABLE_NAME='LOCATION'/COLUMN_NAME='TYPE'.

FR-078 has no delivered mechanism: the hopper Size cell draws the hopper's size text, but nothing on the card opens that size's reference image the way the card's other pictures enlarge. The wizard page itself shows the chosen size's image. Flagged by the US6 worker as the thing T079 would have failed on.

Three worker-level decisions where the inputs were silent: the hopper reference-image source; whether a blank '# of Skids' means 1 (page defaults to 1, the card hides a blank answer rather than replacing it) and that 'Weight of Coil' must be greater than zero; and that FR-085's 'use the typed value as entered' means the normalized (upper-cased, zero-padded) term. Also NCM's priority relative to Outside Service for a part that has both is not stated anywhere: placed after Outside Service and before Finished Goods/WIP, and flagged for clarify.

Workers on this machine cannot fold safely: their append lands in the append-only .spec-context.events.jsonl and the fold is the coordinator's job. Appends from parallel workers on one wave were serialised by folding one at a time with --materialize, and the ticked boxes were reconciled against the journal afterwards (54, 64, 72, 80, 83 and 90 ticked all matched their journal entries with no box lacking one).

Two cells remain declared with no source, by design: Lugger Location on pickup-scrap (no resolver arm, so the cell is hidden, and a future arm reveals it with no card change) and the dunnage Description (declared, provably unfillable, never drawn). Removing the Description declaration is clarify's call, not this step's.

The naming guard's $reswKeyExceptions gained the 11 item cell labels ('Die Location', 'Home Location', 'Scrap Type', 'Coil Number', 'Size', '# of Skids', 'Weight of Coil', 'Die Shop Direction', 'Part Type', 'Item Type', 'Total Qty In House'). A cell's label IS the resource key the card resolves at bind time, so renaming it to the guard's Feature_Element.Property shape would stop it matching the declaration. The exemption is explicit and carries the reason, so a new bare-label key still fails the guard.

This change resolved no living-spec capability, so nothing was loaded before it and nothing was folded after it. Either the areas it touched belong to no capability yet, or a capability claims them and no requirement describes them — `living-validate` names which.

Eight tasks stay unchecked because each needs something this environment cannot supply: T048, T058, T079 and T088 need a rendered waitlist card, which needs a credential the store accepts (the app stops at Sign in and no PIN is available); T067, T068, T069 and T071 need a reachable Infor Visual host. The card's own behaviour for those tasks is pinned by tests, so the gap is end-to-end confirmation, not unbuilt work.

The four pre-existing findings reported by .github/scripts/validate-sql-naming.ps1 (require_password_change in 01_core_users_profile, requires_answer in 31_waitlist_request_item_configs) are untouched and still fail that guard. Both columns exist at HEAD, so they pre-date this work; this round only made the C#/XAML guard honest about its own pre-existing debt.

FR-090 and FR-095 remain carried-forward questions, and FR-092 has gained a third: where NCM sits in the item-type priority for a part that is both at an NCM location and has outside-service work. This work places NCM after Outside Service and before Finished Goods/WIP and flags it for clarify.

Give back's colour is an unresolved disagreement between two settled records: the 012 pre-spec's action-grid table names it amber, while spec 003's ratified action-contracts.md pins it to SystemFillColorSolidNeutralBrush with a written rationale. Left on the neutral because changing it supersedes another feature's contract; raised as D44 for the owner to settle.

Two differences between the built card and the reference mock were deliberately NOT changed, because ratified requirements forbid them: the mock shows a 'Status:' label before the status word and an 'Elapsed: 2h 58m' line under the ring, while FR-008/FR-012 forbid a label in front of the word and FR-021 forbids both a percentage and an elapsed-time line in that zone. The mock also centers the title over the cells with the identifier on its own line, where D21 settles the title as a pair spanning row 1.

T088 stays open and is now narrower: string resolution and the ring's accessible name are verified statically, but keyboard operability, unclipped zones at the default window size, and animations-off usability need the rendered application. The app reaches the Sign in stage but no application credential is available in this environment, so the waitlist itself cannot be driven.

Infor Visual is confirmed unreachable at runtime: the running waitlist shows its own banner, 'Cached data in use - Infor Visual is unreachable. Cached data is being shown. The cached copy is about 10 hours old.' That is FR-002/FR-004 working as designed, and it also means T067, T068 and T069 and T071 cannot be validated from this machine.
